`speech-sample.wav` is a 5-second excerpt of John F. Kennedy's 1961 inaugural
address, taken from the whisper.cpp sample (`samples/jfk.wav`). As a work of
the United States federal government it is in the public domain.

It says "Ask not what your country can do for you." — one complete utterance,
which is what `test_pipeline.py` matches against a scratch grammar to prove the
whole chain works on real speech without needing anyone to talk to a microphone.
